judge_notes.opus5: Item 0 is the strongest in-window case in the pack and carries the number: the ~$66m Q3 guide was built only from export-permit-covered revenue, consensus sits on that floor to the decimal, and the identical construction printed $47.6m against a $34m guide last quarter (+28.7% reaction) and cleared it the quarter before; item 3 adds a short base of 18.3% of shares outstanding that grew 36% since mid-September while the stock fell 28% on sector de-risking, and item 4 adds InP pricing above the level the July EPS guide was set on. The call-rich skew (-14.6 vol points) means part of this is paid for, and item 1 (Q4 consensus already at stated year-end capacity) is the real brake.
judge_notes.opus55: Consensus sits exactly on a guide built only from permit-covered revenue; the same construction printed 40% over guide last quarter (i0). Rising short interest and call skew add to it (i3); Q4 consensus already at capacity is the offset (i1).
judge_notes.sonnet55: Q3 guide built only from permit-covered revenue with consensus sitting on the floor, after +40% and ~+3% overshoots in the last two prints (item 0), with rising short interest and sector washout; partly priced by call skew and the Oct 28 +10.6%.
judge_notes.fable51: Guide built only from permit-covered revenue, consensus parked on it to the decimal, and the same construction printed +40% over guide last quarter; an 18% rising short and call skew amplify, a capacity-capped Q4 guide is the drag.
